en.content:
Topview Motion Studio (powered by Seedance 2.5) lets you upload reference materials, describe what you want to create, and choose a style to generate AE-style motion graphics videos in just a few minutes.

--- QUOTED TWEET ---
Motion graphics that would cost hundreds of thousands of yen if commissioned from a designer
can now be made for just a few coins 🪙

Topview Motion Studio is here. Powered by Seedance 2.5.

No need for timelines, keyframes, or any After Effects knowledge. Just upload reference materials, tell it what you want to make, and choose a style. It’s done in minutes.

#TopviewAI #MotionGraphics #AIVideo
